title: Re-Search: Dissecting LLM Ideation Through a Two-Player Questioning Game
abstract: arXiv:2611.14487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Research ideation is iterative: researchers refine their ideas step by step based on feedback. Yet existing evaluations obscure this search process, making it difficult to understand how LLMs explore the space of research ideas and what limits their progress. We introduce Re-Search, which adapts the format of Twenty Questions to research ideation: given only the research problem of a published paper, a model must rediscover the paper's core idea by asking yes-or-no questions. Built from 200 ICML 2026 papers, Re-Search tracks how a model's idea evolves as it asks questions and receives binary oracle feedback, isolating ideation from execution. Across six recent LLMs, nearly all progress happens within the first 30 of 100 questions, which largely decide how the game ends; after that, most models plateau. translated_title: Re-Search：通过双人提问游戏剖析大语言模型的科研构思能力
translated_abstract: 科研构思是迭代性的：研究者根据反馈逐步完善自己的想法。然而现有的评估方法掩盖了这一搜索过程，使我们难以理解大语言模型如何探索研究想法的空间，以及是什么限制了它们的进步。我们提出了 Re-Search，它将“二十个问题”游戏的格式应用于科研构思：仅给定一篇已发表论文的研究问题，模型必须通过提出是非问题来重新发现该论文的核心想法。Re-Search 基于 200 篇 ICML 2026 论文构建，追踪模型的想法如何随着提问和接收二元神谕反馈而不断演化，从而将构思过程与执行过程分离开来。在六个近期的大语言模型上，几乎所有进展都发生在 100 个问题的前 30 个之内，这些提问在很大程度上决定了游戏的结局；此后，大多数模型陷入停滞。通过对候选问题和假设空间进行受控干预，我们发现瓶颈在于想法的生成，而非判断。
tldr: 提出 Re-Search 基准，将“二十个问题”游戏引入科研构思评估，要求模型仅凭研究问题通过是非提问重新发现已发表论文的核心想法，并发现大语言模型的构思进展几乎集中在前 30 个提问内、其瓶颈在于想法生成而非判断。
en_tdlr: Re-Search adapts the Twenty Questions game to LLM research ideation, requiring models to rediscover a published paper's core idea via yes-or-no questions, revealing that nearly all progress occurs within the first 30 questions and the bottleneck lies in idea generation rather than judgment.
